group.name: Notification Service <-> User Data
group.modules: storage.js (profile) + api.js (posts)  ->  notifications.js (generateNotifications)  ->  App.js tab badge + NotificationsScreen
group.strategy: Bottom-Up Integration: storage and notification units (already tested) are combined first, then driven through App.js and the Notifications/Profile screens.
group.dataPassed: User {name}, posts[] (count, latest title), profile {age} -> notification list [{id, text, read}] -> unread badge count
